process.title: How we work
process.intro: The same five steps for a wedding, a music video or a campaign.

steps.title: Brief
steps.text: Tell us the date, the place and what you need. We reply within one working day with a quote.

steps.title: Plan
steps.text: A 30% deposit holds the date. We build the shot list, storyboard or content calendar with you.

steps.title: Shoot
steps.text: Our crew arrives early, works quietly and covers every moment on the plan.

steps.title: Edit
steps.text: We edit, grade and design. You get one round of changes on every film and design.

steps.title: Deliver
steps.text: Online gallery, films in every format you need, and design files ready for print.

items.q: How far ahead should we book?
items.a: For weddings and Chilanga Mulilo, three to six months ahead, especially from August to December. Music videos and adverts usually need two to four weeks of planning.

items.q: Do you cover both photos and video on the same day?
items.a: Yes. Most of our wedding and ceremony clients book both, with a photographer and a videographer working as one team.

items.q: How long until we get our photos and films?
items.a: Event photos arrive in two weeks, wedding highlight films in four to six weeks. Corporate clients can get edited selects on the same day.
